title: bin/edm-bash-gate is never executed by any test: block translation, all four fail-open guards, the command projection and --help have zero behavioural coverage

Four of six documented op_match operators (regex_match, equals, starts_with, ends_with) are never evaluated by the real evaluator; the fixtures naming them are only checked by a hand-written bash schema validator

The bash and stop events have no match-path coverage: eval bash is never invoked at all, eval stop only with a malformed rule, so the empty-conditions branch and edm-stop-gate's block translation never run
The fail-open half of the hookify allow-path wiring is unproven through either real consumer: nothing asserts a warn match or a hookify setup-error exit 1 fails to escalate into a denial
gg_state_dir's EDM_GATEGUARD_STATE_DIR override branch is never exercised as a working redirect; the one test setting it also engages the kill switch, so the branch never runs

Marker-line parsing is only driven with well-formed three-field markers; a tab-less marker silently allows (verified by hand), disabling Phase 6 fact-forcing for the whole session with no test covering it

The documented [<PREFIX>] argument is never passed by any test: the unresolvable-prefix exit-2 die, the single-prefix scoping branch, the prefix-scoped lint call and the scoped header are all uncovered
Test stack and Coverage posture are never exercised in their applicable state; both awk coverage parsers, _rr_layer_max_pct and _rr_layer_meets_target never see input that makes them true
EDM_GATEGUARD_MAX_DENIALS is never set by any test; only the hardcoded default of 3 is exercised, so the env-reading half of the documented knob is unverified
Rubric signal helpers are only observed at this repository's current values and the sole score assertion is a self-consistency identity that holds for any values, including a never-matching grep
edm-hookify list is invoked once with output discarded to /dev/null; no assertion covers the listing contract, the name fallback, or the omission of disabled rules
MultiEdit tolerant extraction is only driven with the edits[].file_path shape; Claude Code's own single-file shape and the unique de-duplication across both shapes are untested
gg_is_exempt is only driven with a single-entry glob value and the shipped default; the comma-split, empty-element skip, non-** glob form and explicitly-empty value are untested
The per-prefix validate-died continue branch is untested; T46 AC9's two internal-error cases both fail active-initiatives and soft_exit before the loop is reached
Withdrawn: the hookify deny path looked untested from the T45 section but EDMV4-T52 AC7b drives a real block rule end to end and asserts the deny payload
t43_ac9_snapshot uses BSD-only stat -f so the writes-no-files check would be vacuous on Linux, but its paired positive control fails in exactly that case and D43 records Linux as untested
The 50 ms gateguard allow-path budget is measured only by a manual timing.sh mode run-all never invokes -- a deliberate, in-place-documented exclusion matching every other timing.sh mode
edm_project_key's terminal pwd fallback is untested, but the CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR and git-toplevel branches are both covered and the uncovered arm has no branching of its own
The --json write-failure die is untested; a single unconditional redirect behind the family-standard die, on a path with no state to corrupt
